source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
notes: The same constraint also rules out relativization of a conjunct as in (110a-b) because the whole conjoined NP and not just one of the conjuncts is an argument of the predicate (inserting a resumptive pronoun in (110b) doesn’t help). As expected, the whole conjoined NP can be relativized (110c).
en: Ookko’s old style house / something possessed by Ookko that used to be a house (now possibly a ruin) / a house that used to be in Ookko’s possession
